<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
global $wp_registered_settings, $post_type_meta_caps;
$editor_id = wp_insert_user( array(
    'user_login' => 'stage_d1_probe_editor',
    'user_pass'  => 'Probe-Editor-2026!x',
    'user_email' => 'stage-d1-probe@example.test',
    'role'       => 'editor',
) );
$submission_id = wp_insert_post( array(
    'post_type'    => 'raouf_submission',
    'post_status'  => 'private',
    'post_title'   => 'Stage D1 state probe',
    'post_content' => 'PROBE-PII-DO-NOT-SHIP',
) );
update_post_meta( $submission_id, '_raouf_name',  'پروب D1' );
update_post_meta( $submission_id, '_raouf_phone', '09141112233' );
$pto  = get_post_type_object( 'raouf_submission' );
$caps = (array) $pto->cap;
function raouf_d1_caps( $sid, $caps ) {
    return array(
        'read_post'         => current_user_can( 'read_post', $sid ),
        'edit_post'         => current_user_can( 'edit_post', $sid ),
        'delete_post'       => current_user_can( 'delete_post', $sid ),
        'read_private_cap'  => current_user_can( $caps['read_private_posts'] ),
    );
}
wp_set_current_user( $editor_id );
$editor = raouf_d1_caps( $submission_id, $caps );
$q = new WP_Query( array(
    'post_type' => 'raouf_submission', 'post_status' => 'private',
    'posts_per_page' => -1, 'fields' => 'ids', 'perm' => 'readable',
) );
$editor['private_posts_visible'] = (int) $q->post_count;
wp_set_current_user( 1 );
$administrator = raouf_d1_caps( $submission_id, $caps );
// register_setting() runs on admin_init; invoke it so the settings registry is populated.
if ( ! isset( $wp_registered_settings['raouf_options'] ) ) { do_action( 'admin_init' ); }
$settings = array();
foreach ( array( 'raouf_options', 'raouf_media' ) as $name ) {
    $a = isset( $wp_registered_settings[ $name ] ) ? $wp_registered_settings[ $name ] : null;
    $settings[ $name ] = $a ? array(
        'type'              => isset( $a['type'] ) ? $a['type'] : null,
        'group'             => isset( $a['group'] ) ? $a['group'] : null,
        'show_in_rest'      => isset( $a['show_in_rest'] ) ? $a['show_in_rest'] : null,
        'has_default'       => array_key_exists( 'default', $a ),
        'default'           => array_key_exists( 'default', $a ) ? $a['default'] : null,
        'sanitize_callback' => isset( $a['sanitize_callback'] ) ? $a['sanitize_callback'] : null,
    ) : null;
}
$state = array(
    'wp_version'                  => get_bloginfo( 'version' ),
    'php_version'                 => PHP_VERSION,
    'submission_id'               => (int) $submission_id,
    'capability_type'             => $pto->capability_type,
    'map_meta_cap'                => $pto->map_meta_cap,
    'cap_read_post'               => $caps['read_post'],
    'cap_edit_post'               => $caps['edit_post'],
    'cap_read_private_posts'      => $caps['read_private_posts'],
    'cap_edit_posts'              => $caps['edit_posts'],
    'cap_create_posts'            => isset( $caps['create_posts'] ) ? $caps['create_posts'] : null,
    'manage_options_is_meta_cap'  => isset( $post_type_meta_caps['manage_options'] ),
    'editor'                      => $editor,
    'administrator'               => $administrator,
    'registered_settings'         => $settings,
);
file_put_contents( '/wordpress/wp-content/stage-d1-state-probe.json',
    wp_json_encode( $state, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_PRETTY_PRINT ) );
